test_cases.name: happy_path_primary_queue_success
test_cases.description: Normal operation execution when primary queue item succeeds on initial attempt without DLQ routing.
test_cases.input: Process message msg-order-101 on queue orders with max_retries 3.

test_cases.name: retry_exhaustion_quarantine
test_cases.description: Message fails repeatedly until exceeding max_retries (3), triggering DLQ packaging, quarantine persistence, and primary pipeline unblocking.
test_cases.input: Execute msg-order-202 on attempt 3 when previous attempts failed and operation raises timeout exception.

test_cases.name: fatal_schema_violation_fast_track
test_cases.description: Malformed message encounters non-retryable fatal validation error, immediately bypassing retry attempts and routing to DLQ on attempt 1.
test_cases.input: Process corrupted message msg-order-303 failing invariant precondition or schema validation.

test_cases.name: incomplete_dlq_envelope_defect
test_cases.description: DLQ packaging missing required diagnostic dump fields triggers INCOMPLETE_DLQ_ENVELOPE defect.
test_cases.input: Construct DLQ envelope for msg-order-404 without required diagnostic metadata.

test_cases.name: supervisory_triage_redrive
test_cases.description: Operator triggers redrive of quarantined envelope, moving payload back to primary queue.
test_cases.input: Execute supervisory triage redrive on quarantined envelope 22222222-3333-4444-5555-666666666666.

test_cases.name: supervisory_triage_purge
test_cases.description: Operator triggers permanent discard and purge of quarantined envelope.
test_cases.input: Execute supervisory triage purge on quarantined envelope 33333333-4444-5555-6666-777777777777.
